message.reasoning:
Let me evaluate against criteria.

C1 Introduction: mission concept, rationale, number of spacecraft, users. The introduction covers primary mission (coral reef monitoring via fluid lensing), why needed (bleaching), one satellite with justification, users (CSIRO, BOM, government funding). References cited. Good detail. Accomplished, maybe 8.

C2 Mission design: launch (Vega E from Kourou, justification), orbit (SSO 600km, inclination 97.79°, COE table), maneuvers (only EOL), ground control (Mt Pleasant, STK access report), comms frequency (access table, ~10 min mean), mission duration 5 years, EOL drag sail. STK screenshots included (Images 1-5), STK access report. Some issues: "A very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" — error (should be "not desirable" or "undesirable"). Also "images of reef sections will be complied daily" typo. RAAN 27.33° "indicates location of launch facility" — questionable but plausible. Semi-major axis 6971 km correct. Inclination 97.79° for 600 km SSO correct (~97.79°). Drag sail discussion slightly contradictory ("without thrusters... uncontrolled descent... However, the ZYZZsat is without thrust capability and so must use a 'passive' strategy" — redundant). Also no hand calculations shown beyond inclination plot (which appears to be from a source, cited [8]? Actually Image 3 plot not clearly cited). No STK files mentioned in appendix explicitly — screenshots present but "software files" not stated. Coverage analysis: swath discussion somewhat confused. Overall adequate-to-accomplished. Weight 60 — mark maybe 7-8. Given good STK evidence and comprehensive coverage, but some errors and lack of hand calcs, I'd say 7.

C3 Conclusion: summarizes findings, notes caveats. Adequate-to-accomplished. It's fairly specific. 7.

C4 Presentation: structure clear, headings, figures labeled? Figures have captions like "STK 3D view of orbit: 12 hours apart" but no figure numbers ("Figure 1"). Tables not numbered. References are bare URLs, no proper formatting; Wikipedia used as source [6] — task says Wikipedia not acceptable. Reference [5] and [10] have odd artifacts ("f. https", "[10 d.]") — likely OCR. In-text citations match list. Executive summary present. Some grammar issues ("a Earth observation", "complied", "purposed", "current owned"). Adequate level: 5-6. Given Wikipedia use and missing figure numbers, 5.

Requirements:
R1 yes (Introduction).
R2 yes (one satellite, justified).
R3 yes (users: CSIRO, BOM; operator/funding).
R4 yes (Kourou, Vega E).
R5 yes (SSO, COE table).
R6 yes (no maneuvers except EOL).
R7 yes (Mt Pleasant, access table).
R8 yes (5 years, drag sail).
R9 yes (STK used).
R10 partial — screenshots yes, but STK files not explicitly provided/appendix not mentioned.
R11 partial — structure good, citations present but Wikipedia used and reference formatting poor.

Technical issues:
- "A very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" — contradiction.
- Wikipedia cited [6], not acceptable per task.
- Drag sail paragraph redundant/contradictory.
- Figures lack figure numbers.
- RAAN initial value justification weak.
- No hand calculations for inclination (plot source unclear).
- "complied" typo, "purposed", "current owned" — minor grammar.

Overall: solid design report with good STK evidence; minor errors and referencing issues.
